你們你們你? Bigger.
One. Five P's live together in a pod.
Will we live here forever? Asked one P.
No. We'll grow bigger and stronger.
Then one day, we'll leave this pod and see the world. answered another
P.
Two. The P's grew bigger and bigger.
One day, a boy picked the pod. We'll soon see the world! said the P's.
They were very excited.
Three. The boy took the P's out of the pod.
You'll make good bullets! he said.
Four. I'll see the world! said the first P.
I'll fly to the sun! said the second P.
The third and the fourth P's were lazy.
We're happy anywhere. We only want to sleep. they said.
The fifth P said. I'll do something useful.
Five. One by one, the P's flew into the sky.
Six. The first P fell on a roof, and a bird ate it.
The second P fell into some water.
The third and fourth P's fell into a yard, and two chickens ate them.
The fifth P hit a window and fell on the ground.
Soon, it grew into a plant with some green leaves.
Seven. A girl was ill. She looked out of her window and saw the plant.
The P is growing bigger and taller. It must be strong.
I'll try to do the same. she said.
A few weeks later, the girl got well. her mother said.
Thank you little P.
